hardwareHubs.note: Once known as Precision Valley for its machine tool industry, and home to the Black River Innovation Campus.
Home to the Generator makerspace and to precision machining shops serving medical device and aerospace customers.

makerspaces.name: Generator
makerspaces.note: Member makerspace at 40 Sears Lane whose site mentions a metal shop, general tools and tool certifications.

events.name: Vermont Tech Jam
events.note: Free tech career and innovation expo run by Seven Days since 2008, with its 2025 edition on October 25 at Hula.

programs.name: Black River Innovation Campus Actuator
programs.note: Startup program for technology, advanced manufacturing and advanced computing ventures, with a campus that hosts tenant companies.
